svg.text: L35 — brief DN volleys do NOT reliably re-time the self-rhythmic cord (PRC < 3x sham; deflection is transient)
L32 substrate, paired-noise heterodyne PRC, 3 seeds x 8 phase bins; volley lands only when it lifts DNg95 over the relu floor
volley phase in gait cycle (deg; heterodyne angle of motor mean)
A — PRC (3-seed mean): max 18.9 deg, below gate
B — strongest bin, paired noise (motor mean)
time from volley onset (s) — rhythm survives, phase relaxes back
volley duration 250 ms vs 1 s (seed mean)
C — persistence at the strongest bin (A=.15)
